verses.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ اَضَلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Those who disbelieved, and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, He (Allah) has rendered their deeds vain.

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاٰمَنُوۡا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلٰي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّهُوَ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡۙ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ وَاَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: And those who believed and did righteous deeds and believed in that which is revealed to MuHammad,-and it is the truth (that has come) from their Lord-He will write off their evil deeds, and will set aright their state of affairs.

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الۡبَاطِلَ وَاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الۡحَقَّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ اللّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ اَمۡثَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: That is because the disbelievers have followed falsehood, while the believers have followed the truth (that has come) from their Lord. This is how Allah explains their (respective) situations to the people.

verses.ar: فَاِذَا لَقِيۡتُمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَضَرۡبَ الرِّقَابِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَثۡخَنۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ فَشُدُّوا الۡوَثَاقَۙ فَاِمَّا مَنًّاۭ بَعۡدُ وَاِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتّٰي تَضَعَ الۡحَرۡبُ اَوۡزَارَهَا ࣢ۚࣞۛ ذٰلِكَؕۛ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ لَانۡتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡۙ وَلٰكِنۡ لِّيَبۡلُوَا۠ بَعۡضَكُمۡ بِبَعۡضٍؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ قُتِلُوۡا فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ فَلَنۡ يُّضِلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: So, when you encounter those who disbelieve, then (aim at) smiting the necks, until when you have broken their strength thoroughly, then tie fast the bond, (by making them captives). Then choose (to release them) either (as) a favour (shown to them,), or (after receiving) ransom,until the war throws down its load of arms. That (is Our command.) If Allah willed, He would have (Himself) subjected them to retribution, but (Allah ordered you to fight,) so that He may test some of you through some others. And those who are killed in Allah’s way, He will never let their deeds go to waste.

verses.ar: سَيَهۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَيُصۡلِحُ بَالَهُمۡۚ‏
verses.en: (Instead,) He will guide them, and will set aright their state of affairs,

verses.ar: وَيُدۡخِلُهُمُ الۡجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: and will admit them to the Paradise He has identified for them.

verses.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ تَنۡصُرُوا اللّٰهَ يَنۡصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: O you who believe, if you will help (the religion prescribed by) Allah, He will help you, and will stabilize your footings.

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَتَعۡسًا لَّهُمۡ وَاَضَلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: As for those who disbelieve, (destined) for them is destruction, and He has rendered their deeds vain.

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاَحۡبَطَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: That is because they hate what Allah has sent down; therefore Allah has nullified their deeds.

verses.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ دَمَّرَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡؗ وَلِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اَمۡثَالُهَا
verses.en: Have they not travelled in the land so that they might see how was the end of those before them? Allah brought utter destruction to them. And (ready) for (these) disbelievers are the likes thereof.

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوۡلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاَنَّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ لَا مَوۡلٰي لَهُمۡࣖ‏
verses.en: That is because Allah is the supporter of those who believe. As for the disbelievers, there is no supporter for them.

verses.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُدۡخِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يَتَمَتَّعُوۡنَ وَيَاۡكُلُوۡنَ كَمَا تَاۡكُلُ الۡاَنۡعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثۡوًي لَّهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Surely, Allah will admit those who believe and do good deeds to the gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy (the worldly life), and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire is the final abode for them.

verses.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَخۡرَجَتۡكَۚ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: How many a town, stronger in might than your town that has expelled you, have We destroyed! Then, there was none to help them.

verses.ar: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ كَمَنۡ زُيِّنَ لَهٗ سُوۡٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Then, can one who holds on to a clear proof from his Lord be like those for whom their evil deeds are beautified, and who followed their desires?

verses.ar: مَثَلُ الۡجَنَّةِ الَّتِيۡ وُعِدَ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَؕ فِيۡهَا٘ اَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ اٰسِنٍۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ لَّبَنٍ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهٗۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشّٰرِبِيۡنَ ࣢ۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّيؕ وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوۡا مَآءً حَمِيۡمًا فَقَطَّعَ اَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: (Here is) a description of the Paradise that is promised for the God-fearing! In it there are rivers of water, never spoiling, and rivers of milk the taste of which would not go bad, and rivers of wine, delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of honey, fully purified. And for them there are all sorts of fruits, and forgiveness from their Lord. Are they like those who will live in Fire forever, and will be given boiling water to drink, and it will tear their bowels into pieces?

verses.ar: وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعُ اِلَيۡكَۚ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا خَرَجُوۡا مِنۡ عِنۡدِكَ قَالُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ اٰنِفًاࣞ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Among them there are ones who (pretend to) give ear to you, until when they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are the ones on whose hearts Allah has put a seal, and they have followed their desires.

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اهۡتَدَوۡا زَادَهُمۡ هُدًي وَّاٰتٰىهُمۡ تَقۡوٰىهُمۡ‏
verses.en: As for those who have adopted right path, Allah improves them in guidance, and gives them their piety.

verses.ar: فَهَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةًۚ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ اَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَاَنّٰي لَهُمۡ اِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرٰىهُمۡ‏
verses.en: They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour (of Doom) that it should come upon them suddenly. So, its signs have already come. Then, once it will come upon them, how would they have an opportunity to accept the advice (already) given to them?

verses.ar: فَاعۡلَمۡ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوٰىكُمۡࣖ‏
verses.en: So, be assured that there is no god but Allah, and seek forgiveness for your fault, and for (the faults of) the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows your moving from place to place and your permanent abode.

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُوۡرَةٌۚ فَاِذَا٘ اُنۡزِلَتۡ سُوۡرَةٌ مُّحۡكَمَةٌ وَّذُكِرَ فِيۡهَا الۡقِتَالُۙ رَاَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ يَّنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ الۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ الۡمَوۡتِؕ فَاَوۡلٰي لَهُمۡۚ‏
verses.en: And the believers say, “Why has a (new) Sūrah not been revealed?” Then, once an operative Sūrah is sent down, and fighting (in Allah’s way) is mentioned in it, you notice those who have disease in their hearts, looking to you like one who is faint because of death. So, destruction is very close to them.

verses.ar: طَاعَةٌ وَّقَوۡلٌ مَّعۡرُوۡفٌࣞ فَاِذَا عَزَمَ الۡاَمۡرُࣞ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُوا اللّٰهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرًا لَّهُمۡۚ‏
verses.en: The (reality of their) obedience and (truthfulness of their) speech is fully known (as being mere deception). So, had they been truthful to Allah when the matter had become serious, it would have been much better for them.

verses.ar: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوۡ٘ا اَرۡحَامَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: So, (O hypocrites,) do you not apprehend that, in case you turn away (from Jihād ), you will spread disorder in the land and will sever your ties of kinship?

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فَاَصَمَّهُمۡ وَاَعۡمٰ٘ي اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed; so He has made them deaf, and made their eyes blind.

verses.ar: اَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُوۡنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ اَمۡ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبٍ اَقۡفَالُهَا
verses.en: Then, do they not give serious thought to the Qur’ān, or do they have locks on their hearts?

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ ارۡتَدُّوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَدۡبَارِهِمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الۡهُدَيۙ الشَّيۡطٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡؕ وَاَمۡلٰي لَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Surely those who turn back after the guidance has appeared to them clearly, it is Satan who has tempted them and involved them in far-fetched fancies.

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ كَرِهُوۡا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ سَنُطِيۡعُكُمۡ فِيۡ بَعۡضِ الۡاَمۡرِۚ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ اِسۡرَارَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: That is because they say to those who hate that which Allah has revealed, “We will obey you in some respects.” And Allah knows their secret talk.

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ اِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُوۡنَ وُجُوۡهَهُمۡ وَاَدۡبَارَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: So, how (miserable) will they be when the angels will exact their souls, smiting their faces and their backs?

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوۡا مَا٘ اَسۡخَطَ اللّٰهَ وَكَرِهُوۡا رِضۡوَانَهٗ فَاَحۡبَطَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡࣖ‏
verses.en: That is because they followed that which has angered Allah, and they disliked His pleasure; therefore He has nullified their deeds.

verses.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يُّخۡرِجَ اللّٰهُ اَضۡغَانَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Do those having malady in their hearts think that Allah will never expose their grudges (against Islam)?

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَاَرَيۡنٰكَهُمۡ فَلَعَرَفۡتَهُمۡ بِسِيۡمٰهُمۡؕ وَلَتَعۡرِفَنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ لَحۡنِ الۡقَوۡلِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ اَعۡمَالَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: Had We willed, We would have shown them to you (by identifying each one of them,) so as you would definitely recognize them by their features. However, you will recognize them by the tone of (their) speech. And Allah knows (all) your deeds.

verses.ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتّٰي نَعۡلَمَ الۡمُجٰهِدِيۡنَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَالصّٰبِرِيۡنَۙ وَنَبۡلُوَا۠ اَخۡبَارَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: And We will certainly test you until We know those of you who carry out Jihād (struggle in Allah’s way) and observe patience, and until We check your episodes.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَشَآقُّوا الرَّسُوۡلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الۡهُدٰيۙ لَنۡ يَّضُرُّوا اللّٰهَ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَسَيُحۡبِطُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Those who disbelieve and prevent (others) from Allah’s way, and oppose the Messenger, after the Guidance has appeared to them clearly, shall never bring harm to Allah in the least, and He will render their deeds vain.

verses.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوا الرَّسُوۡلَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوۡ٘ا اَعۡمَالَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not nullify your deeds.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوۡا وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ اللّٰهُ لَهُمۡ‏
verses.en: Those who disbelieved and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, then died as disbelievers, Allah will never forgive them.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَهِنُوۡا وَتَدۡعُوۡ٘ا اِلَي السَّلۡمِࣗۖ وَاَنۡتُمُ الۡاَعۡلَوۡنَࣗۖ وَاللّٰهُ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَنۡ يَّتِرَكُمۡ اَعۡمَالَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: So, do not lose heart, and do not appeal for peace; you will be the uppermost, and Allah is with you; and He will never deprive you of your deeds.

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٌ وَّلَهۡوٌؕ وَاِنۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا وَتَتَّقُوۡا يُؤۡتِكُمۡ اُجُوۡرَكُمۡ وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمۡ اَمۡوَالَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: The worldly life is but play and pastime. If you believe and be God-fearing, He will give you your rewards, and will not ask you your riches.

verses.ar: اِنۡ يَّسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوۡهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُوۡا وَيُخۡرِجۡ اَضۡغَانَكُمۡ‏
verses.en: If He were to ask you of it, and press you (to spend all your wealth), you would show miserliness, and He would expose your disgusts.

verses.ar: هٰ٘اَنۡتُمۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنۡفِقُوۡا فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِۚ فَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّبۡخَلُۚ وَمَنۡ يَّبۡخَلۡ فَاِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖؕ وَاللّٰهُ الۡغَنِيُّ وَاَنۡتُمُ الۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَاِنۡ تَتَوَلَّوۡا يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡۙ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُوۡنُوۡ٘ا اَمۡثَالَكُمۡࣖ‏
verses.en: Yes, you are such that you are called upon to spend in Allah’s way, but some of you withhold in miserliness- and he who withholds in miserliness withholds against himself- and Allah is the Need-Free, and you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you by some other people, then they will not be like you.
